section.title: Agents
section.line: The built-in agents and your own: how each is used, its model, instructions and what it may do.

groups.title: Agents
groups.note: Plan is what /plan turns on. Your own agents work when you name one in a message, or when an agent hands one part of a task; Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok and Antigravity get your subagents too.

items.title: Build
items.line: A mode · The default agent: it can change files and run commands.

choices.title: Mode
choices.line: A mode new sessions can start in.

choices.title: Subagent
choices.line: It works when you name it in a message, or when another agent hands it part of the work.

choices.title: Both
choices.line: A mode, and a subagent other agents hand work to.
